topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon a folder on his laptop, hidden, like a secret I hadn't seen coming. Inside, page after page, typed out in neat rows, was a story. A story about us, or at least his version. Every scene, every twist, it was like living in a book I didn't choose to read. I scanned through, my heart pounding with each word that mirrored our life, yet twisted into something unfamiliar. I can't shake the images, the words, swirling in my head. I need to talk to him, to understand, but the words are stuck, trapped in my throat, as the story plays on, leaving me to sift through the pages of a reality I didn’t know we were writing together.
